title: Velvety Brazilian Mung Bean Sprout Bowl
description: A funky and creamy Brazilian dish featuring mung bean sprouts, served in a stone bowl, perfect for a low glycemic meal. This recipe combines the best of Brazilian cuisine with a healthy twist.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the mung bean sprouts, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the sprouts are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the mung bean sprout mixture in a stone bowl, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
